description.zh: 集中管理账号偏好与系统配置的功能页面：一侧是稳定的设置导航（通用、通知、安全等分区）， 另一侧是行式表单列表——每行一个"标签 + 控件 + 说明"，低频修改、即改即存。 页面按配置域分区而非按任务流组织，用户靠扫读标题定位，改完即走。
description.en: A utility page for managing account preferences and system configuration: a stable settings nav on one side (general, notifications, security…), and rows of "label + control + hint" forms on the other — low-frequency edits, saved as they change. Organized by configuration domain rather than task flow; users locate sections by scanning titles, change, and leave.

use_when.zh: 账号资料、通知、安全等偏好集中管理
use_when.en: Central management of profile, notifications, security

use_when.zh: 配置项多、需要分区导航定位
use_when.en: Many options that need sectioned navigation

use_when.zh: 修改低频但需要随时可达的入口
use_when.en: Edits are infrequent but the entry must stay reachable

avoid_when.zh: 高频操作流（应放进对应工作界面）
avoid_when.en: High-frequency task flows — put them in the working surface

avoid_when.zh: 只有 2～3 个开关的极简产品（并入菜单即可）
avoid_when.en: Minimal products with two or three toggles — fold into a menu

avoid_when.zh: 需要管理员审核的审批流页面
avoid_when.en: Approval workflows that need admin review

note.zh: 左侧分区导航 + 右侧表单，最常见
note.en: Sectioned nav left, forms right — the common default

note.zh: 顶部 Tab 切换配置域，适合少分区
note.en: Top tabs switch domains — good for few sections

note.zh: 所有分区纵向滚动一页到底
note.en: All sections scroll vertically on one page

note.zh: 轻量设置以弹窗承载，不离开当前页
note.en: Lightweight settings in a modal, no page exit

note.zh: 按分区分组，标出当前所在分区。
note.en: Grouped by section, marking the active one.

note.zh: 每个分区只放一类设置，标题与说明清晰。
note.en: One category of settings per section with a clear title and description.

note.zh: 标签 + 控件 + 帮助文本，即时保存或统一保存二选一。
note.en: Label, control and help text; pick instant or batched saving, not both.

note.zh: 删除 / 注销等不可逆操作，红色隔离并二次确认。
note.en: Irreversible actions isolated in red with a second confirmation.

note.zh: 未保存时出现，明确「有改动未保存」状态。
note.en: Appears when dirty, making the unsaved state explicit.

notes.zh: 侧栏变体：nav sticky，内容区按分区渲染行式表单（label 左、控件右）。 分组单页变体用锚点 + scroll-margin 联动高亮当前分区。行式表单切换控件用受控 switch；有未保存更改时底部浮出保存条（sticky bottom）。危险区用红色边框与 二次确认弹窗隔离在页面末尾。
notes.en: Sidebar variant: sticky nav, content renders row-style forms per section (label left, control right). The single-page variant links anchors with scroll-margin and highlights the active section. Toggles are controlled switches; when unsaved changes exist, a sticky bottom save bar appears. Isolate the danger zone at the end with red borders and a confirm dialog.

basic.zh: 创建一个设置页面，包含分区导航、行式表单和保存按钮。
basic.en: Create a settings page with sectioned navigation, row-style forms and a save button.

design.zh: 创建侧栏式设置页：左侧分区导航（通用、通知、安全、账单），右侧每区一组行式表单（标签 + 说明 + 开关/输入）；通知区含邮件/推送/短信三个开关；页面底部红色"危险区"（删除账号，需二次确认）；有未保存更改时右下浮出保存条。
design.en: Build a sidebar-style settings page: left nav (General, Notifications, Security, Billing), right side row-style forms per section (label + hint + toggle/input); notifications has email/push/SMS toggles; a red "Danger Zone" (delete account with confirmation) at the bottom; a save bar floats when there are unsaved changes.

implementation.zh: 用 React + Tailwind 实现设置页：设置项数据驱动（{section, rows:[{label, hint, type}]}）； switch/input 受控；脏状态驱动保存条显隐（sticky bottom + toast 反馈保存成功）； 危险区按钮触发确认弹窗；分区切换支持键盘与 aria-current。不新增依赖。
implementation.en: React + Tailwind settings page: data-driven options ({section, rows:[{label, hint, type}]}); controlled switches/inputs; dirty state drives a sticky save bar with toast on success; danger-zone button opens a confirm dialog; section nav supports keyboard and aria-current. No new dependencies.

agent.zh:
在当前项目中实现设置页。

先检查现有设置入口、表单组件与 Design Token，保持一致。
要求：
- 分区导航 + 行式表单（数据驱动）
- 开关、输入受控，有未保存提示与保存反馈
- 危险区二次确认
- 深浅色一致，键盘可访问
- 不新增依赖
完成后运行现有检查，说明修改文件。
agent.en:
Implement the settings page in the current project.

Inspect the existing settings entry, form components and design tokens first; stay consistent.
Requirements:
- Sectioned nav + data-driven row forms
- Controlled toggles/inputs with unsaved-changes hint and save feedback
- Danger zone with confirmation
- Consistent light/dark; keyboard accessible
- No new dependencies
Run existing checks when done and list modified files.
